title: catapodium loliaceum
intro: Catapodium loliaceum, commonly known as Wood Sorrel or Lollipop Grass, is a species of flowering plant in the family Poaceae. This perennial grass has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Catapodium loliaceum include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and promote wound healing, making it a valuable resource in folk medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
